Vendored CSL styles and locales
================================

The files in this directory are copied unmodified from the Citation Style Language projects:

  apa.csl
  chicago-author-date.csl
  deutsche-gesellschaft-fur-psychologie.csl
      Source: https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles (master, fetched 2026-10-23)

  locales-de-DE.xml
  locales-en-US.xml
      Source: https://github.com/citation-style-language/locales (master, fetched 2026-10-23)

License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
Each file carries its own <rights> element and its list of authors and contributors
(<author>, <contributor>) in the header. Those headers must stay intact.
The files are redistributed as separate data files and are not merged into citegeist source code.
Any modified copy of a style or locale must be released under the same license.
